messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — tiny accessibility sweep before we freeze the dashboard release. two things I'd love eyes on: 1) screen-reader verbosity for the model/control toolbar (compact vs descriptive labels) and 2) keyboard/tab crossing when you open the right-side flyout (focus lands, escapes, and tab wrap).

Matt: def — I'll check the tab order and focus trap. noticed the focus ring gets clipped on the secondary btns in dark theme. can repro locally.

Jordan: +1 to both. for SR verbosity we should prefer explicit aria-labels on actionable icons and use an aria-describedby for supplemental info, not overloading aria-label. avoid duplicating the visible label in the SR text.

Anya: good point. example: the compact UI shows an icon-only "rerun" action. current label is just "Rerun". thinking to change to "Rerun model with same inputs" for SR. thoughts?

Jordan: that reads better. also set role=button on custom svg wrappers and tabindex=0 if not a native button. and add aria-pressed for toggle state on streaming toggle.

Matt: re: focus ring in dark theme — prob CSS specificity. quick patch: 
```
.button:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.icon-only:focus { box-shadow: none; }
```
I'll open a PR shortly.

Dee (QA): repro steps for the tab-crossing bug: open dashboard -> Tab into global actions -> press Tab until focus is on "Model details" button -> press Enter to open flyout -> press Tab twice. Expected: focus goes to first interactive element in flyout. Actual: focus wrapped back to top nav. Haven't tried with screen reader yet.

Sam: tradeoff question — longer SR labels are great, but they make the visible tooltip awkward. can we use aria-label for SR and visually-hidden text for the longer phrase? keep visible label short.

Jordan: yep, use <span class="sr-only"> for the verbose text and keep the visible text terse. that's the standard. ensure the screen reader only gets the text once: prefer aria-label on the button if the DOM renders both visible text and sr-only.

Anya: plan: Matt fixes focus ring + trap, Jordan writes a small a11y guidance snippet for icon labels and toggles, Dee verifies tab behavior and tests with VoiceOver/JAWS, Sam to confirm product tradeoffs for tooltips. I'll collate into a tiny checklist.

aria-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: keyboard focus order, visible focus indicators, ARIA roles & labels, skiplinks, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components. See https://a11y-checklist.local/.

Matt: PR opened: #3492 — includes focus trap fix and updated focus styles. added comment with the CSS snippet above. cc @Jordan for aria suggestions.

Jordan: quick nit in PR — the toggle needs aria-checked not aria-pressed. also the flyout should set aria-modal="true" while open. small change, adding a comment.

Dee (QA): testing notes after Matt's PR: focus trap fixed in Chromium, still odd in Firefox if you shift-tab from first element — it focuses the body. filing a cross-browser issue.

Anya: thanks all. next steps: Jordan will draft the icon-label doc and post it here, Dee files the firefox follow-up, Matt will iterate on the PR per comments. I'll update release checklist to mark this a11y pass required before deploy. :thumbsup:

Sam: sounds good. if anyone needs copy help for SR wording I can jump in.

Jordan: posting draft guidance in ~30m.

Anya: awesome — closing this thread once Jordan posts and Dee confirms fixes.
